decisions.rationale: Chondroma is a distinct entity from the described lesion in the vignette.
Benign chondroma does not match the malignant characteristics described in the vignette.

option_relations.rationale: Chondroma is a distinct entity from the described lesion in the vignette.
The description of the lesion and its location matches the characteristics of low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone.
Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement is a more specific instance of low-grade chondrosarcoma of the temporal bone.
Benign chondroma does not match the malignant characteristics described in the vignette.
